title: Layer Graph Crates: Canvas/Graph Separation
description: Extract the generic graph-canvas engine out of puzzle/2d into infinite/cavas and mathematical/graph bundles, leaving puzzle/2d with only puzzle tooling (brush/fill/palette). Build DAG's own Rust-rendered IO-node canvas with playground dev harness and dag.fixture/v1 fixture.
summary: Implemented composable graph crate chain: mathematical_graph -> mathematical_graph_port -> mathematical_graph_port_directed -> mathematical_graph_port_directed_normal (+ dag sibling). Purged graph logic from infinite_cavas. puzzle/2d depends only on the normal leaf. cargo test: infinite_cavas 3, puzzle_2d 108, dag 4, flow_core 3.
